svg.title: Dye manufacture flow
svg.desc: Block flow diagram from raw materials through unit processes, intermediates, dye-forming steps, isolation and finishing
svg.text: Dye manufacture: from raw materials to the commercial dye
Crude → intermediate → dye is the guiding sequence of the dye industry
benzene → nitrobenzene → aniline → benzenediazonium chloride + naphthalene → β-naphthol → coupling → Sudan I (crude)
→ salted out, filtered, dried and standardised to commercial strength.
